intended_object: A projection functor from the poset of compatible pairs (source discrete quotient, target discrete quotient) to the poset of target discrete quotients. It is internal reindexing machinery for writing a profinite map as a limit of maps between finite stages (docstring and use in `surjectiveFintypeMap` and `surjectiveTargetIndex_initial`).
explanation: The definition turns the monotone map `P ↦ P.1.2` on the subtype `SurjectiveIndex f` into a functor. That subtype consists of pairs (A, B) with A ≤ B.comap f, ordered componentwise. The construction is correct: monotonicity in the second component follows from the componentwise order. It is an auxiliary device for proofs. Together with the source projection, it reindexes the limit cones of X and Y over a common cofiltered index, so that f becomes a limit of finite-stage maps. This follows the Neukirch–Schmidt–Wingberg exercise. It has no standalone counterpart in the mathematical literature, so it is a technical device rather than a mathematical object.
